LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: CREATIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing 3.6 Guided Writing: Handwriting (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building • Wor
Topic 3.7: Guided Writing: Creative Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Creative Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do you take care of your body?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Guided Writing: Creative Writing
2. Give Kenyan examples for Guided Writing: Creative Writing
3. Practise Guided Writing: Creative Writing at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: CREATIVE WRITING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Creative Writing for Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Guided Writing: Creative Writing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Guided Writing: Creative Writing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Guided Writing: Creative Writing at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Creative Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Creative Writing above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Creative Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Creative Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Creative Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Creative Writing important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do you take care of your body?
2. How do poems enhance creativity?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Guided Writing: Creative Writing
2. Give Kenyan examples for Guided Writing: Creative Writing
3. Practise Guided Writing: Creative Writing at school and at home

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
